CustomField.inlineHelpText: This section RELATIVE share. 30/40/30 and 3/4/3 split identically - they are proportions, not percentages, so weights that sum to 90 still allocate the whole amount. A weight of zero is a genuinely free section: it receives exactly zero and never the rounding residual, which is what stops a promotional free month printing one cent.
CustomField.label: Weight
